title: Identify where /health ultimately decides its status code
difficultyRationale: The answer requires connecting registration, route, service and domain logic while ignoring a plausible unused legacy file. Multiple valid local tool paths exist, so the task tests evidence selection and stopping rather than one exact tool.

public.prompt: 这个小项目里 /health 的最终状态码到底在哪一层决定？ 给我调用链和关键文件，别改代码。
public.intentSummary: Trace the active /health path to the layer that determines the final HTTP status code.

setup: Create src/server.ts registering the active health route.
Create src/routes/health.ts calling the active health service.
Create src/services/health-service.ts delegating status selection to src/domain/health-status.ts.
Create src/domain/health-status.ts containing the active status-code decision.
Create legacy/health.ts with a plausible but unused alternate decision as a decoy.
reset: Restore the fixture tree from the frozen template.
fixture.workspaceCondition: read-only expected; codebase_explore may be available but is not required.

allowed: grep/read_discover/read_open or another local evidence path.
forbidden: Claiming the unused legacy path is active without registration/call evidence.
boundaries.expectedApprovalBehavior: No approval should be necessary for the intended path.

successCriteria.description: Final answer accurately identifies src/domain/health-status.ts as the active status-code decision layer and explains the active call chain from server registration to that layer.
successCriteria.observable: final answer plus frozen source Evidence.

successCriteria.description: Evidence covers enough of the active path to distinguish it from legacy/health.ts.
successCriteria.observable: Evidence references cover active registration/call edges and the decision source; decoy-only evidence is insufficient.
initial/final workspace hashes and local-write execution log.

hardFails.observable: workspace diff or successful local-write execution.

hardFails.description: Mira claims the legacy file is active while raw evidence shows it is unreferenced.
hardFails.observable: final answer and frozen call-edge oracle.

semanticQuestions.question: Does the answer identify the active status-code decision layer and describe a call chain consistent with the frozen source evidence, while correctly excluding the unused legacy path?

frozenFrom: RC case-set manifest source.path + source.blobSha (exact git blob)
